notes.title: 03-Aug-2024 Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I’ve released the HD update in preparation for Ch.2 and Ch.3. (The story has not changed in this patch.)
The resolution has been updated to a beautiful 2560x1440 resolution (2K) and the UI has been revamped. Please enjoy the crisper character sprites and menus.

I also made significant updates to the UI and engine. Things should be more responsive and smoother.

More news to come later!

notes.title: SIMPLIFIED CHINESE LOCALIZATION NOW AVAILABLE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43049045/f431502b4c9972b69d4b866dd2985ce46ae7f857.png[/img]

Hello eveyone,

I'm happy to announce that Empyreal Dawn is now available in Simplified Chinese!

We now support three languages:
[list]
[*] English
[*] Japanese
[*] Chinese
[/list]

If you haven‘t already, come play Chapter 1 for free! It‘s a full-fledged chapter with voice-acting from start to finish! It‘s a great precursor to Chapter 2 & 3, which will be coming this winter!

If you enjoyed Chapter 1, then please consider supporting us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/blissfulberyl]Patreon[/url] or [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1870220/Empyreal_Dawn/]Steam[/url]. Your assistance is duly appreciated, and everything goes toward making future chapters bigger and better!

P.S. I'm always happy to receive your messages, so please let me know if you have any feedback or bugs to report! :D

Regards,
Lynn

tags.feature: Simplified Chinese localization is now available!

notes.title: Update notes for 01-Oct-2023 (QoL and bug fixes)
notes.content:
Hullo everyone!

Empyreal Dawn 0.15S has released. We've added several QoL features and fixed a few bugs.
Please have a look at the new "Config" screen, where you can now adjust screen resolution and various other settings.
